summary: Full row of bays in a retail car park, nearest house 36 m.
reasons: Bays full of cars, van blends in

drivers.seclusion: Shops to the west, a roadside verge and the road to the east; the nearest mapped houses are 36 m away to the south.
drivers.access_and_room: Marked bays open off the lot's aisle and the lot has no gate; the row is nearly full, so a space may be hard to find.
drivers.traffic: Busy road about 15 m away beyond a verge; the lot is busy by day.
drivers.convention: Many cars are parked in the row, so a van would blend in; no campervans seen and overnight rules unknown.

flags: Retail car park: overnight rules unknown
Marshall Lane has No Stopping Any Time and Bus Zone signs, which apply to the road rather than the bays
sun_shade: Open; a large tree shades the south end, and the row is lit by sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is closed at night

best_section.where: Bay row along the east edge of the car park, beside the roadside verge on Marshall Lane
